categories.label: Economy
categories.blurb: Dompet, bank, reward berkala, kerja, quest, checklist, shop, dan market.

commands.name: tcash
commands.summary: Dompet, bank, reward harian/mingguan/bulanan, kerja, transfer, shop, dan history.
commands.note: Semua transaksi memakai idempotency key dan tidak bisa membuat saldo minus.
subcommands: tcash shop / tcash buy <id> [qty] / tcash sell <id> [qty]

commands.name: tgive
commands.summary: Transfer 666 Coins ke member lain dengan tax server dan idempotency.

commands.name: tvote
commands.summary: Klaim hadiah vote 666 Coins setiap 12 jam.

commands.name: tquest
subcommands: tquest / tquest list — quest harian & mingguan

commands.name: tchecklist
commands.summary: Checklist quest harian dan mingguan beserta progress kamu.

commands.name: tsell
commands.summary: Jual monster, item shop, atau semua duplikat monster.

commands.name: tmarket
commands.summary: Lihat listing, sell, buy, cancel, mine, dan history dengan escrow.
commands.usage: tmarket [list] [halaman] | tmarket sell <monster|pet|item|egg> <id> <harga> | tmarket buy <id> | tmarket cancel <id>
commands.note: Listing memakai escrow dan short ID; item tidak bisa dipakai saat dikunci.

commands.name: ttrade
commands.summary: Trade aman: item dikunci dan dua pihak wajib confirm.
commands.usage: ttrade @user [koin] | ttrade offer <id> coins <n> monster <id> pet <id> item <id> <qty>
commands.note: Item dikunci selama transfer dan baru berpindah setelah kedua pihak confirm.
subcommands: ttrade offer <id> coins <n> monster <id> pet <id> item <id> <qty>
ttrade confirm <id> — kedua pihak wajib confirm

commands.name: tpet
